name: @zydraxyl/dracondex-sdb
description: DraconDex central SQLite schema — the one source both the Electron and Flutter apps generate their vault DDL from

scripts.generate: node schema/generate.mjs && node schema/entity-kinds.mjs && node supabase/setup/gen.mjs && node templates/build.mjs && node design/tokens.mjs && node tools/build-manifest.mjs
scripts.check: node schema/generate.mjs --check && node schema/entity-kinds.mjs --check && node supabase/setup/gen.mjs --check && node templates/build.mjs --check && node design/tokens.mjs --check && node tools/build-manifest.mjs --check && npm test
